sn31.1:1.1: ti || || Sāvatthi || Tatra || voca || || Gandhabbakāyike vo bhikkhave deve desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || Katame ca bhikkhave gandhabbakāyikā devā || || Santi bhikkhave mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave sāragandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave pheggugandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave tacagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave papatikagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave pattagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave pupphagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave phalagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave rasagandhe adhivatthā devā || santi bhikkhave gandhagandhe adhivatthā devā || || Ime vuccanti bhikkhave gandhabbakāyikā devā ti || ||
